purpose: mechanism surface for the oracle-to-degraded scene-graph study; requires scene graphs, which Test-Dev does not publish and which the spent internal slices cannot supply without circularity
status: PARKED / CLOSED WITHOUT EXECUTION 2026-08-10 — no model has been run on it and none ever was; the slice remains frozen and unspent. Exploratory, reused-image, 50%-relate-enriched mechanism screen. Not a confirmatory endpoint.
exclusion: spent QIDS only; spent IMAGES are not excluded
limitation: The QIDs were not used on any of the named spent surfaces. That is the precise claim and it is WEAKER than 'the questions are new': reused images can carry near-duplicate or entailed questions, so QID novelty does not establish content novelty. 2,849 of 3,000 images were touched by a spent slice. Valid for within-question graph-corruption contrasts on frozen checkpoints, where pairing removes the image main effect. Pairing does NOT establish that image x corruption interaction, source compatibility, or design adaptation to previously-seen images is absent or directionless -- the direction of any such bias is UNKNOWN, not assumed negligible. NOT a fresh absolute-accuracy endpoint; never quote its accuracy as one, and never compare it to Test-Dev.
why_not_strict: Excluding spent images too leaves 1,028 images and at most ~950 questions, of which relate could supply only 156 — too few to resolve a retained-headroom difference across 3 encoders and 8 arms.

stratification.why: relate is the primary mechanism category; the slice is not population-representative and must not be reweighted to look like one

scene_graph_stats.note: relation count was NOT used as a selection criterion; filtering on it would bias the slice toward rich scenes and inflate every relation-deletion effect

selection_regime: Exploratory/development mechanism screen. Selection IS permitted, but only under the frozen promotion rule in research/graph_degradation/PREREGISTRATION.md section 5. Corrected in v1.1 (2026-08-08, MSG-048 audit): this field previously read false while the design promotes up to three error families, and promotion is selection.

preregistration.note: PARKED / CLOSED WITHOUT EXECUTION 2026-08-10. The study was never run: no arm scored, no independent clearance, no Stage-B promotion. Preserved as reproducible future work; no dissertation claim rests on it.

spent_surface_image_disjoint_subset.definition: questions whose image appears in no spent slice
spent_surface_image_disjoint_subset.use: Descriptive inventory only. It has NO inferential, promotion or rescue role. The VERIFIED property is only that these questions' images are disjoint from the named spent surfaces; that does not establish semantic or content novelty, independence, or general cleanliness. Renamed from 'strictly_clean_subset' on 2026-08-09 (MSG-051) because 'strictly clean' claimed more than image-disjointness.

visible_surface.note: The canonical visible fact surface. Every coverage figure, the G4/G7 unit and both frequency tables are derived from it, so an unpinned copy silently redefines them.

builders.note: An artifact whose builder is not frozen can be rebuilt differently and still match its own description. v1.4's replay vectors had no committed generator, which is why nobody could see they applied two of the three declared donor conditions.

corruption_module.note: The eight Stage-A arms. Operates on the frozen visible fact set; selection stays in the deterministic contract. v1.10 repair: fact text is rebuilt on mutation, treatment is observed not recomputed, G3 bystander erasure is recorded.

corruption_tests.note: Executable form of the §3.1 fixtures and the §3.2 invariant; every guard has a recorded mutation.
